The separate ownership review approved the parser boundary, closed validation, immutable models, diagnostics and bounded transport; exact commands, tool versions, source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are retained.
Parser tests and the independent request-contract corpus preserve labeled pattern identity, reject duplicate IDs/keys and cover escapes, long text, bounds, modes and diagnostic positions.

The request contract continues to mark source metadata and execution as proposed; positional and named examples are tested as scalar request payloads, and no unverified SQL constructor or collection binding is advertised.
The parser enforces a pre-parse scalar cap, pattern/count/scope bounds, strict JSON depth/options and immutable output, and performs no filesystem access.

knownLimitations: The request parser is implemented in W08-S01, while search.many source metadata, shared matching and query execution remain later W08 scopes; the documented SQL forms remain explicitly proposed and no unverified constructor is advertised.
The scalar transport cap is 8,388,608 UTF-16 characters; pattern, count and scope limits are independently enforced. The parser is request admission code, not a scan-hot-path benchmark target.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 existing expected skips and 3 platform-conditional symlink skips; no package was published, pushed, released or installed.
